description.p: ClipStory is a lightweight clipboard manager that automatically stores everything you copy. It automatically stores everything you copy and lets you quickly search, reuse, and manage your clipboard history.

ul.li: Automatic clipboard monitoring — never lose a copied item again
Search through your clipboard history instantly
Pin important items so they never get deleted
Configurable history limit, remembered across launches
Auto-start at login option, running quietly in the background
Auto-start now runs in the background without opening a window at login
History limit and dark mode preferences are remembered across launches (GSettings)
Re-launching the app reopens the window even while running in the background

description.p: Wayland polling de-duplication, guaranteed history save on quit, plus stricter history trimming.

ul.li: Fix overlapping Wayland clipboard requests (single chain with retry cancel)
Save pending history when the app exits
Trim pinned items when the history limit is reached

description.p: AppCenter review fixes: correct metainfo validation, proper form factor recommends, and release tag for v1.5.1.
AppCenter readiness: new Application ID, Flatpak manifest, AppStream metainfo, and file restructuring.
GitHub screenshot previews and README improvements.
Wayland clipboard support with polling fallback, memory leak fixes, and improved stability.
Double-click to copy items. Minor UI improvements.
Pin/unpin items, pin persistence, auto-migration from legacy format.
Background monitoring, debounced persistence, Ctrl+Q shortcut, various bug fixes.
Configurable history limit, JSON persistence, dark mode toggle, autostart toggle.
